prompts.chen:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original development sprite artwork for an isometric SCP facility RPG. Detailed classic late-1990s PC RPG sprite treatment akin to the visual density of Fallout 2, with grounded adult proportions, visibly pixelated stepped shading, rich restrained colors and material texture. Original artwork, no copied game assets, no logos, lettering, labels, grids, watermark, neon, cartoon/chibi or low-color NES style. Neutral soft overhead/front-left lighting suitable for later engine tinting. Crisp visible pixel structure, no blurry painting or smooth vector gradients.
Transparent-background sprite ATLAS ONLY, landscape canvas 1536x1024. EXACT layout: SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows, each cell 256x256. No lines or labels. Exactly ONE full-body same person per cell, 24 total sprites, fully inside its cell with generous clear margin. Fixed elevated three-quarter camera showing head tops and shoulders, feet at the lower center of every cell, sole baseline near cell y=236, center x=128. Uniform apparent body height about 200 pixels. Six directions by COLUMN left to right: (1) facing upper-right, back-right three-quarter, (2) facing directly screen-right in side profile, (3) facing lower-right, front-right three-quarter, (4) facing lower-left, front-left three-quarter, (5) facing directly screen-left side profile, (6) facing upper-left, back-left three-quarter. ROW 1 relaxed standing idle, ROW 2 walking left-foot contact, ROW 3 walking passing step, ROW 4 walking right-foot contact. Each row keeps those same six facings and same identity/clothes. Feet apart naturally, arms swinging gently during walking, no held tools or weapon. Entire head/limbs/boots always visible, no cropped sprite, no touching other cells. Genuine transparent background, no ground plane, no checkerboard, no shadow outside a small contact shadow under the feet. Clothing details must be readable at reduced game size. This is a registered directional sprite sheet rather than a character lineup or concept poster.
Subject: CHEN, a Foundation security employee. Adult human, short dark close-cut hair, medium warm skin, clean-shaven, ordinary sturdy physique. Practical charcoal security shirt and dark grey trousers, dull slate-blue protective vest, black duty belt and sturdy black boots. Subtle desaturated teal shoulder panels for visual recognition. No helmet or mask. Modest ID badge without text. Keep exactly the same person and clothing across all 24 cells.
